next_gate.error: ordered Vulkan segment ending at packet 72 failed before vkCmdDraw/vkQueueSubmit because the provider did not confirm enabled 4x-to-1x depth/stencil SAMPLE_ZERO resolve

latest_retail_replay.runtime_cause: The P2 plugin DSO used in this replay was built against an SDK header lacking the optional resolve overload. Its own CreateShiftVulkanProvider helper therefore selected the geometry-only overload and left resolve false. The runtime-owned Xenos graphics provider is a separate object and does not control the P2 Native provider.
